about.title: About Me
about.description: Hi, I'm Arda Güner. I started with C++ and today I build projects across web, mobile and game development.
detailedDescription: Hello, I'm Arda Güner. I started my software development journey with C++, and the grounding it gave me in algorithms and memory management still shapes how I approach every new technology. Over time I moved into modern web technologies and built a strong technical foundation there. I develop sustainable, high-performance, user-focused web applications with the JavaScript ecosystem — React, TypeScript and Node.js in particular — as well as Next.js and ASP.NET Core. I see software not just as a job, but as a continuously evolving problem-solving discipline.

These days my focus is on game development: desktop game projects in Python and Delphi, and mobile and web games with Godot 4 and Phaser 3 + Matter.js. On mobile I build user-friendly, scalable applications with Flutter and Dart, and use Capacitor to bring my web-based games to mobile platforms. I'm also actively learning Kotlin and continually working to deepen my technical expertise on mobile platforms.

In the past, I worked as a coding and computer science instructor, helping children develop algorithmic thinking and problem-solving skills. In Scratch-based workshops, my focus was not only on teaching how to code, but on building systematic thinking, step-by-step reasoning, and a creative, productive mindset.
Alongside these, I solo-develop independent (indie) games under my own game studio, Ardeko Studios, bringing my creative concepts and gaming passions to life.
